corpus_summary.areadata_crc_resolution: 48851 of 48851 records (100%) resolved against the 2112-entry property CRC index
corpus_summary.era_note: Zero beta-era maps in this corpus. Every sector directory that exists carries the full modern 10-file set (areaambiencedata, areadata, areaproperty, attr.atr, height.raw, minimap.dds, shadowmap.dds, shadowmap.raw, tile.raw, water.wtr). The mapformat README claim that metin2_map_c1 is a 5-file beta map is FALSE here: c1/000000 holds all ten files. Only three sector-level exceptions exist - metin2_map_boss_awaken_skipia and metin2_map_boss_crack_skipia hold one sector each containing only attr.atr, and metin2_map_smhdungeon_02 sectors lack minimap.dds. Every map is therefore tagged era=modern.

corpus_summary.terrain_source_note: 31 maps carry ParentMapName. 26 of those have no sector directories at all and are pure client-side proxies that reuse the parents terrain; 5 (smhgate_a1/b1/c1, smhgate_devils, boss_*_skipia) ship a partial sector subset.

field_empire.label: Empire temperate field and capitals (B-family terrain)
field_empire.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 15 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
field_empire.evidence: All members draw terrain exclusively from d:/ymir work/terrainmaps/B/**. metin2_a1.txt, metin2_b1.txt, metin2_c1.txt, metin2_b_fielddungeon.txt and metin2_map_t1.txt are BYTE-IDENTICAL 17-texture palettes (md5-verified); metin2_a3/b3/c3/wedding_01 carry the same 11-texture subset list. Trees are exclusively the b1_/b3_ deciduous SpeedTree set - all 618 tree records in a1 are b-family (561 b1_* + 57 b3_*), zero n1_/n2_. Empire identity is carried ONLY by the building family, never by terrain or fog: zone/a/building in a1 (54 objs), zone/b/building in b1 (282), zone/c/building in c1 (71) - and a1.msenv is byte-identical to c1.msenv, so terrain plus environment alone cannot separate the three capitals. smhgate_a1/b1/c1 are 3-sector cut-outs of a1/b1/c1 with the parents setting.txt copied verbatim.

field_valley.label: Green valley / three-way field (A-family terrain)
field_valley.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 3 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
field_valley.evidence: Exclusive use of terrainmaps/A/** (a/beach, a/field, a/grass, a/stone, a/tile - the 10 textures of metin2_a2.txt). Jaccard against the field_empire B-palette is 0.00, a hard split on the primary evidence axis. All four maps declare Environment A2.msenv (fog 0.36 0.43 0.39, unique in the corpus). map_a2 and map_n_threeway are byte-identical map CONTENT (md5 over every sector file) - threeway is a verbatim copy of A2 relocated by BasePosition.

desert.label: Desert and desert frontier
desert.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 8 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
desert.evidence: n/desert/{field,grass,sand,stone} terrain family; metin2_n_desert1.txt and metin2_map_golden_land.txt hold identical 12-texture lists. Nine of the ten members declare Environment milgyo.msenv (fog 0.90 0.80 0.67, cloud clouds_zone01) - the second largest environment-sharing group in the corpus. Flora is the n2_ arid SpeedTree set - all 1149 tree records in n_desert_01 are n2_ arid species (n2_aloevera_rt_flowers 276, n2_cinnamonfern 184, n2_joshuatree 81). Props come from zone/n/desert and zone/n/obj/map_n_desert_01. wl_01 + nusluck01 additionally share the metin2_wl_01.txt palette and are the vegetated desert-fringe variant (wl_01: 361 of 451 tree records are n2_, 80%). sungzi_desert_hill_01/02/03 are byte-identical to each other.

snow_field.label: Snow field / snow mountain
snow_field.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 5 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
snow_field.evidence: Single terrain family n/snow.m; all six declare TextureSet metin2_N_snowm.txt AND Environment N-snowm01.msenv - a perfect 6:1:1 map/textureset/environment group, the cleanest cluster in the corpus. Flora is exclusively the n1_ winter set - all 853 tree records in map_n_snowm_01 are n1_ (n1_coloradobluespruce_rt_01/02/03 = 337, n1_beech_rt_winter/02/03 = 331). Props from zone/n/obj/snow.m (356 in the reference map). sungzi_snow_pass01/02/03 are byte-identical to each other.

flame_field.label: Flame land / volcanic field
flame_field.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 5 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
flame_field.evidence: Single terrain family 'n/flame area'; metin2_n_flame_01.txt (7 textures) and metin2_boss_entrance.txt (8) have Jaccard 0.88. Every member renders with fog 0.52 0.21 0.11 over cloud clouds_zone02 (map_n_flame_01.msenv and map_boss_entrance.msenv carry identical Fog blocks). Vegetation is only the dead-vine pair b2_ivyspy_rt_winter/_winter2 (286 of 286 tree records in n_flame_01). Props from zone/n/obj/map_n_flame_01 and zone/dungeon/flame_dungeon. sungzi_flame_hill_01/02/03 are byte-identical to each other.

darkforest_coast.label: Dark-forest coast and Devils Dragon Island continent
darkforest_coast.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 5 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
darkforest_coast.evidence: Chained terrain palettes: metin2_mtthunder.txt is a subset of metin2_capedragonhead.txt (which is Jaccard 0.58 to metin2_map_e1.txt), metin2_bayblacksand.txt = bayblacksand + capedragonhead, metin2_dawnmistwood.txt = bayblacksand + dawnmistwood. The decisive shared evidence is the object palette: zone/devils_dragon_island/** is dominant in every member with terrain (bayblacksand 531, capedragonhead 440, mt_thunder 407, dawnmistwood 358, e1 51). It does occur outside the cluster, but only as scenery filler at 2-36 records per map - the largest such use is dawnmist_dungeon_01 (36), which is this continents own dungeon. e1_01/02/03 are ParentMapName proxies of metin2_map_e1.

ice_valley.label: Snake valley / white-dragon ice valley
ice_valley.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 3 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
ice_valley.evidence: metin2_map_snakevalley.txt and metin2_map_whitdragonvalley.txt have Jaccard 0.48 and both mix capedragonhead + n/snow.m + snakevalley terrain; icecrystalcave declares metin2_map_whitdragonvalley.txt outright. zone/snakevalley props appear in snakevalley (329) and icecrystalcave (3). n/snow.m props plus n1_ winter trees dominate whitdragonvalley (177 props / 146 trees) and icecrystalcave (166 / 273), which is what separates this cluster from darkforest_coast despite the shared capedragonhead textures.

eastplain.label: Eastplain and empire castle
eastplain.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 4 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
eastplain.evidence: All four use the zone/eastplain art family and nothing else in the corpus does (zone/eastplain** record totals: eastplain_01 397, _02 328, _03 248, empirecastle 99 including zone/eastplain/building 22). eastplain_01/02/03 share TextureSet metin2_eastplain.txt; empirecastles palette overlaps it at Jaccard 0.30 through the shared empirewar/tille folder. eastplain_01.msenv and eastplain_03.msenv are byte-identical and empirecastle.msenv repeats their Fog (0.24 0.35 0.36). Jaccard against the empirewar texturesets is below 0.25, which is why eastplain and empire_war are kept apart.

empire_war.label: Empire siege-war arenas (three seasonal skins)
empire_war.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 3 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
empire_war.evidence: Three 2x2 siege maps that are one layout in three seasonal skins: metin2_map_empirewar01/02/03.txt use the mutually exclusive terrain folders empirewar/snow, empirewar/summer and empirewar/desert with matching environments snowm02.msenv / A1.msenv / desert_02.msenv. Object palettes follow the skin exactly (zone/n/obj/snow.m 148 | zone/b/obj 139 | zone/n/desert 147). battlearena01/02/03 are terrain-less ParentMapName proxies of empirewar01/02/03 with the parents setting.txt copied.

guild_village.label: Guild village and small guild-war grounds
guild_village.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 4 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
guild_village.evidence: The guild_village terrain folder is used by exactly these maps: metin2_guild_village.txt, metin2_guild_war1.txt and metin2_guild_war3.txt (the last two byte-identical), plus gm_guild_build.txt at Jaccard 0.71. metin2_guild_war1.msenv and metin2_guild_war3.msenv are byte-identical. guild_village_01/02/03 are mapproperty-only proxies (ParentMapName metin2_guild_village) with NO setting.txt at all. NOTE: guild_war2, guild_war4 and guild_01/02/03 carry 'guild' in the name but sit on plain field palettes with zero guild art, so they land in field_empire / field_valley - 'guild' is a server function, not a visual identity, and the filename-based guild cluster does not survive the evidence.

arena_pvp.label: PvP arena, OX event and shop plaza
arena_pvp.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 6 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
arena_pvp.evidence: Small flat plazas built from the zone/duel prop set (duel 72, pvp_arena 72, oxevent 35) over zone/b/building plazas (oxevent 100, privateshop 80, guild_battle_base 34). duel and pvp_arena both declare TextureSet metin2_duel.txt + Environment A1.msenv and hold the identical 157-object palette; oxevent and privateshop both declare metin2_map_oxevent.txt + a1.msenv. guild_battle and guild_battle_base share metin2_map_guild_battle.txt + metin2_map_guild_battle_01.msenv and the bespoke zone/guild_battle prop set. Highest object density in the corpus: 110-253 objects per sector on 1x1-2x2 grids, against a corpus median near 33.

dungeon_block.label: Flat black-box block dungeon (interior)
dungeon_block.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 18 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
dungeon_block.evidence: Interior box dungeons. The single-texture palettes metin2_map_anglar_dungeon_01.txt, metin2_map_deviltower1.txt and metin2_n_saguidungeon.txt are byte-identical (one dungeon/*.dds); metin2_map_spiderd.txt and metin2_map_smhtower_d.txt add only one or two more. Environments are black fog (dark.msenv, skipia_dungeon.msenv and monkeydungeon_02/03.msenv all Fog 0.00 0.00 0.00; moonlight04 0.12/0.12/0.16; anglar 0.05/0.00/0.10). Geometry is 77-100% DungeonBlock+Effect with zero Tree records. 18 of the 19 maps in the corpus that write TerrainVisible 0 are in this cluster (the 19th, whitedragoncave_01, is in dungeon_themed). Formal separation rule applied: textureset texture count <= 5 AND maximum fog channel <= 0.20.

dungeon_themed.label: Themed dungeon / ruin (biome-skinned interior)
dungeon_themed.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 12 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
dungeon_themed.evidence: Same interior construction as dungeon_block but skinned to a parent biome, so each fails that clusters rule: themed multi-texture palettes (devilscatacomb 12, dawnmistwood_dungeon 9, otherworld_01 8, n_flame_dungeon_01 6, secretdungeon 6, whitedragoncave 4) and coloured environments (flame 0.51/0.28/0.14, snow 0.10/0.78/0.94, otherworld 0.69/0.16/0.07, whitedragoncave 0.54/0.58/0.82, dawnmist 0.16/0.16/0.23). Blocks come from one dedicated zone/dungeon/<theme> or zone/<theme> family per map (dawnmistwood_dungeon 618, secretdungeon 542, otherworld 505, whitedragoncave_01 301, flame_dungeon 188, snow_dungeon 73). The eight boss_awaken_*/boss_crack_* plus smhgate_dawnmist and smhgate_devils members are ParentMapName proxies of the maps above. otherworld_02 is included despite sitting on the field_empire B-palette because 84% of its objects are zone/secretdungeon (209) and zone/otherworld (114) - object evidence overrides terrain evidence here.

elemental.label: Elemental (Sungma) forest zones
elemental.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 4 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
elemental.evidence: All four texturesets (metin2_map_elemental_01/02/03.txt, with elemental_04 declaring elemental_01s) contain the elemental_01 terrain folder plus the same b/tile + capedragonhead + guild_village fillers, and nothing else in the corpus touches the elemental_01 folder. metin2_map_elemental_01.txt is shared by elemental_01 and elemental_04. Object palettes are 76-94% Tree with essentially no buildings - the structural signature of this cluster. elemental_01 and elemental_02 also carry the undocumented Environment1 / EnvironmentRange1-2 split-environment keys.

trent_forest.label: Trent night forest
trent_forest.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 2 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
trent_forest.evidence: Both declare TextureSet metin2_map_trent.txt (terrain family trent/{field,grass,stone,tile}, used by no other map) and near-identical night environments trent.msenv (fog 0.15 0.06 0.06) and trent02.msenv (0.13 0.05 0.05), both on cloud clouds_zone05. Object palette is b1_/b3_ deciduous trees over generic zone/b/obj with no bespoke building family, which is why they are not folded into field_empire: the terrain palette is disjoint from B/**.

event_instance.label: Bespoke event / instance stage
event_instance.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 10 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
event_instance.evidence: Residual class defined by a positive structural rule, not by a shared palette: every member owns a bespoke single-use art family (zone/dungeon/temple_dungeon 655 in 12zi_stage, zone/geuglagsa 484 in snake_temple_01, zone/treasure_hunt 150, zone/defensewave 104, zone/mists_of_island 89, zone/miniboss 36+7, zone/metin2_guild_pvp 4, and battleroyales 37-texture all-biome palette - the widest in the corpus) plus its own TextureSet and its own .msenv used by no other map. They are small instanced stages, median 3x3. Two members are format-notable: metin2_map_treasure_hunt is the ONLY map that writes the extended 'CRC#sx#sy#sz' areadata token (288 of 288 records), and metin2_12zi_stage carries Environment1..Environment8.

dev_stub.label: Developer test stub
dev_stub.typical_size_basis: modal MapSize over the 4 member(s) with their own terrain; ties broken by the reference map
dev_stub.evidence: Unfinished scratch maps. Hard evidence: metin2_map_t2/t3/t4 have BasePosition 6400,0 / 32000,0 / 57600,0 - multiples of the 6,400 server sector but NOT of the 25,600 client sectree, which the format requires for sectree alignment; besides gm_guild_build they are the only maps in the corpus that violate it. metin2_map_t1/setting.txt contains a corrupt stray line 'ungeon2.msenv' (a truncated Environment value the tokenizer swallows as a valueless key). Their texturesets are verbatim copies of shipped ones (metin2_map_t1.txt is byte-identical to metin2_a1.txt; t3 and t4 share metin2_map_t3.txt) and t1.msenv is byte-identical to t2.msenv. No bespoke art family exists: every object is generic zone/b/obj plus b-family trees.
